title: Moffat — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Moffat.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Canadian Value." Value tier. Moffat is the Canadian entry-level brand from GE Appliances — basic appliances at the lowest GE price point, sold exclusively in Canada. Equivalent to Hotpoint in the US market.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Canadian budget buyers. Builder-spec projects in Canada. Rental properties.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Moffat:

• GE quality at Canadian budget pricing

• Exclusively Canadian distribution

• Lowest-cost option from a major manufacturer in Canada

• Parts available through GE Canada network

• Simple, reliable basics
